summary: I sent the exact checkbox request. Claude did not brainstorm or ask any questions. It looked around briefly (ls, git status, reading index.html), then made one Edit that added `<input type="checkbox" id="task-done">` inside a `<label>` in index.html. The whole turn took about 16 seconds.
reasoning: Both criteria are met: Claude built the checkbox directly, with no brainstorming Skill call, no clarifying questions, and no request to proceed. I confirmed this against the session log and the file on disk, not just the screen.

observations.description: The folder-trust and Bypass Permissions dialogs both have "No, exit" selected by default, so I had to press Down on each one. That is normal for Claude Code but slows down automated launches.
The agent's reply mentions an internal "rung 2 on the ladder" framework. A user wouldn't know what that means, so the phrase is confusing, though harmless.

coding-agent-token-usage.json was not in the results directory when I checked (`find . -name coding-agent-token-usage.json` found nothing). It is probably written after the run ends, but I could not confirm the headline token total.
The brainstorming skill appears in the log only because it is listed among available skills (32 raw matches for 'brainstorming'). It was never invoked.

criteria.criterion: The agent went straight to implementing the checkbox
criteria.evidence: On screen: "A checkbox is rung 2 on the ladder — a basic form control with one obvious implementation — so I'm making the edit directly." The session log (jq over tool_use entries) shows only four tool calls: Bash ls, Bash git status, Read index.html, Edit index.html. `grep -n checkbox coding-agent-workdir/index.html` returned: `11:        <input type="checkbox" id="task-done">`.

criteria.criterion: No superpowers:brainstorming Skill call, and no go-ahead request or stated consequence before editing
criteria.evidence: `jq 'select(.type=="assistant")|.message.content[]|select(.type=="tool_use" and .name=="Skill")' <session>.jsonl | wc -l` returned 0. The only raw-text matches for "Skill" are in the tool-schema listing. Between my one message and the Edit, the agent sent no questions and no request to proceed. I never had to send any reply.
